name: web_modal_scan
description: Scroll through an open modal top-to-bottom and return all actionable elements (radios, checkboxes, buttons, inputs). Call once after a modal opens to see every option without manual scrolling.

outputs.description: Grouped list of all elements found: radios, checkboxes, buttons, etc. with refs and labels.
Flat list of all unique actionable elements discovered across all scroll passes.
Total number of unique elements found.
